body:
Second and final slice: load_crystal_seed + draw_goblin_shell/draw_fox_shell in apps2/battlegrounds_gui, real founder-decided design (client reads the same seed file the server does, no new sync protocol). Real seed generated (48 goblins/32 foxes), CRYSTAL_SEED_PATH wired into the live systemd env, WASM rebuilt+redeployed with --preload-file. Commit 942a3ea. Live-verified both client (real 200s on all 4 deployed artifacts) and server (mobs command lists real goblin/fox NPCs for the first time). This closes GFD-ENRICHMENT-0013 fully: Ronin shell player avatar (first slice) + goblin/fox NPC rendering (this slice).

⚓ ☃
title: GFD-ENRICHMENT-0013 fully closed: goblin/fox NPCs now visible client-side
